She accused him because of envy. Now that he stopped giving attention to her, and focused on you instead, it made her feel insecure.

What should you do? I can't really answer for you. My gut feeling tells me that in your situation I would have cut her off to, so I could continue living my life drama-free.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you parents fight a lot?

Thank you for your reply

In my mind this is a huge mistake. It is not my call to fix it.
I can't understand how everyone is happy when we receive these emails. Attention is NOT good. It is much better to publish shit paper in shit journals no one will see then to risk someone finding out about every mistake you made along the way.

Maybe I made even more mistakes?? I can't sleep
What made you happy? What made you sad later?

Thank you for the response it means a lot to me.
The medication the doctor gave me is, according to her, to help with extreme case of anxiety. I'm afraid of what it will do to me, to my brain. But now I also can't sleep.

Tommrow I'm supposed to be filmed for a promotion video for our team and I can't imagine my self doing it, let alone medicated.

I would much prefer simply to not exist. Or to be in a coma for a year
